$comment: Accepted HIGH/CRITICAL production advisories (phase 11 M3). Each entry needs a GHSA id, the package, a justification and an expiry date (YYYY-MM-DD); an expired entry blocks CI again. Checked by apps/api/scripts/security/audit-gate.ts. "imageExceptions" are the accepted Trivy (OS package) findings of the Docker images: each has a CVE id, reason and expiry, and must match .trivyignore exactly (apps/api/test/unit/image-exceptions.test.ts).

exceptions.reason: postcss 8.4.31 is pinned by next 15.5 and only processes our own CSS at build time; the file read needs an attacker-controlled sourceMappingURL in CSS, which never reaches it.
Same dependency path as above (next > postcss 8.4.31): only our own, build-time CSS is processed; no untrusted CSS input exists in the product.

Only inside the Prisma CLI config loader (@prisma/config), which merges only our own prisma.config.ts; the stack exhaustion needs an attacker-supplied recursive object graph, which never reaches it. Prisma is pinned at 7.10.0 (ADR / CLAUDE.md).
Transitive dependency of the Prisma CLI; SmartOps uses PostgreSQL only, the MySQL driver is never loaded.

Build-time only: braces 3.0.3 comes in through shadcn (a dependency of the panel because globals.css imports shadcn/tailwind.css) > ts-morph > fast-glob > micromatch. It expands glob patterns in the shadcn CLI; the stack exhaustion needs an attacker-supplied, deeply nested pattern, and no untrusted pattern ever reaches it. Neither the API nor the panel image contains braces (checked 2026-10-03). No fixed version exists yet (fix: null): re-check when the exception expires.

imageExceptions.reason: Out-of-bounds write via a crafted regular expression in pcre2. Node uses its own regex engine (V8), not pcre2; libpcre2 is only used by system tools in the base image that never receive user input. Tracker: https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2026-103111
imageExceptions.removeWhen: Renovate moves node:24.21.0-bookworm-slim to a digest with libpcre2-8-0 10.42-1+deb12u2: delete this entry and the line in .trivyignore in that same PR.
